items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Issue 1035 asks for reviews_expected, opt-in strictness (config + CLI) with nonzero exit and named missing legs, and a partial marker in the review state; all three are implemented, default behaviour from #670 unchanged (tested).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: A malformed require_all_legs value degrades to the default instead of crashing; a min-reviews above the roster size fails honestly; the total-failure degraded path keeps its own semantics.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new input surface beyond two CLI flags parsed by argparse (int / bool); no secrets, no shell.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 16 tests assert outcomes of the envelope, the resolver and the marker CLI; each tagged to the new acceptance criterion; the pre-existing 694 review tests still pass.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra config load in emit_envelope (a small JSON read).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New logic lives in lib/external_review_strict.py so the grandfathered bloat-baseline files do not grow; ruff clean.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Envelope JSON gains reviews_expected/missing_legs/strict_* (additive); review-state marker gains partial/missing_legs only when requested; config gains require_all_legs (default false). Existing readers ignore unknown keys.
